acceptance: A table test covers R0 to R1, R0 to R2 on a repeated fingerprint or no effort step, R2 to stop-as-spec on an earlier fingerprint, and no headroom at R0 and at R1 (red test first)
A property test: no input gives more than two raised tries, a tier above max_tier or an effort above max_effort
halt and spec never climb; unknown never passes R1
With no healthy family at the target tier the decider records LADDER_NO_HEADROOM, goes from R0 to R1, and stops at R1
Every decision records the rung that the shadow critic arm chooses
With no bound keys set, the bounds are max_tier deep and max_effort high
fix: TDD first (red test before code), 100% coverage on new and changed functions, zero comments, the package note updated.
summary: Component L2 of ADR-0142 in go/internal/retryladder. A pure Next(state, class, fingerprint, headroom) gives R1, R2 or a stop (spec §2, plan D3-D9). Reuse the one-tier raise of go/internal/convergence; add no second tier table. Bounds: max_tier deep and max_effort high by default (operator decision 2026-10-19); never max effort, never top tier unless named. Records the shadow critic arm (D12). Spec docs/architecture/retry-ladder.md §2 and §4; ADR-0142.
title: Retry ladder L2: the rung decider with the skip, stop and headroom rules
